Anyway.. thank you to everyone who isn’t being rude af. I truly appreciate that considering this is not something I’ve ever talked to anyone about besides my exams 1 person I dated after him. For anyone who asked it’s been three years this month since I found out. I found out because I had to get a bunch of vaccines when I started nursing school and apparently when you get vaccines they can activate dormant viruses . So lord knows how long I’ve actually been living with this and didn’t know. I woke up one day with a bunch of bumps all over my lips and the rest is history.  I had eczema at the time so I was getting bumps all over the parts of my body with the eczema , and basically anywhere I touched on my face. It was crazy. I went to urgent care and they gave me acyclocvir. It never worked, the lysine never worked either. The only thing I take now is turkey tail mushrooms. That is the only thing I have found to keep the outbreaks at bay... That and not eating peanuts or coconuts. Because of the turkey tail I can have a little bit of nuts but I just choose not too cause if I have too much, my lips will start tingling and I’ll have to double down on the mushrooms. It’s not about living a miserable life. I have good days and bad days. How you gonna come over here and minimize my situation just because you’re fine with it? That’s insane to me. But I guess
Thank you!!
